description: The Kanguru Defender Elite 200™ is a 256-bit AES hardware encrypted USB flash drive. It is used to securely store sensitive data housed on the device. It can also be used as a secure platform for remote access and virtualized applications run directly from the device. The device supports onboard hardware random number generation, RSA, HMAC and algorithms.
